title: The 5 biggest mistakes beginner programmers make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The biggest mistake is assuming "the" AI tool fits all — one-size-fits-all thinking leads to poor code and wasted time.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: "5" mistakes are concrete, actionable — listing them helps beginners avoid pitfalls like ignoring version control or misusing APIs.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: "The" approach is more flexible — using the right tool for the job avoids rigid frameworks that stifle innovation.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But without listing the 5, beginners don't know where to start — clarity from specific mistakes is critical for learning.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The 5 biggest mistakes are the 5 most common — focusing on them saves time and prevents recurring errors.
